story.label: My story
story.title: From Accountancy to Information Technology.
paragraphs: I'm currently studying at Angeles University Foundation as an Information Technology student. My journey has not always been easy or straightforward. Before I became an IT student, I was an Accountancy student, and changing my course was one of the hardest decisions I have ever made.

Moving forward does not always mean staying on the same path. Sometimes it means having the courage to change direction when you discover that your interests, strengths, and goals are somewhere else. Instead of regretting my decisions, I choose to learn from them and become a better version of myself.
